hook: Six decades after a 23-year-old vanished, modern DNA testing is finally reopening the case.

sections.voiceover: Six decades after a 23-year-old vanished, modern DNA testing is finally reopening the case.

On October 12, 1963, Barbara Lunsford left her Lexington home for a doctor's appointment. She never made it to that doctor's appointment. Can expanded department resources finally solve the 1963 disappearance?
Lexington Police are using DNA testing in the 1963 disappearance, but the trail went cold.
Lexington Police are utilizing expanded department resources to review the Barbara Lunsford case. The Lexington Police Department unsolved case unit features 2 detectives and 2 officers.
Barbara Lunsford remains missing after 63 years.
